Affects the interpreter concrete eval (InterpExpressions.ml Rem OPanic) AND all three backend models (Lean IScalar.rem + CheckedOps, F* scalar_rem, Coq Primitives.v which also mis-returned Ok x for x%0). BOTH targets + all backends (fix parent is upstream 004e11fe -> predates the fork; present in upstream main). The campaign's contribution is only INDEPENDENT REPRODUCTION: the Phase-2 semantic differential, on a hand-written MIN%-1 test, flags native (overflow-checks=on) PANIC integerOverflow vs Lean #eval ok 0 -> MISMATCH, validating that the oracle catches this soundness class. Verified firsthand.
